agent_config_file.description: Path on the host of the CloudWatch agent configuration from the deploy bundle (review R2: not an SSM parameter, which the plan role could not read).

data_device.description: Device name of the data volume attachment (AUT-108); Amazon Linux links it to the NVMe device. A constant, so the document is known at plan time.

name_prefix.description: Document prefix (veda): the bootstrap deploy role may run veda-deploy, the evidence role veda-collect.

repository_url.description: AUT-105 repository URL built from the account and region (known at plan time); the image is pulled by digest.

after.content: {"description":"Collect Veda staging host evidence into the evidence bucket (no secrets, no personal data)","mainSteps":[{"action":"aws:runShellScript","inputs":{"runCommand":["set -uo pipefail","LABEL='{{ label }}'; TS=$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ); D=$(mktemp -d); cd \"$D\"","TOKEN=$(curl -sS -m 2 -X PUT http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token -H 'X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 60'); IID=$(curl -sS -m 2 -H \"X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: $TOKEN\" http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id)","{ date -u +%FT%TZ; uname -a; cat /etc/os-release; rpm -q docker amazon-cloudwatch-agent amazon-ssm-agent; } \u003ehost.txt 2\u003e\u00261","{ docker version; docker compose version; docker images --digests; docker ps -a; } \u003econtainers.txt 2\u003e\u00261","API=$(docker ps -q -f name=api | head -1); if [ -n \"$API\" ]; then docker exec \"$API\" python -c 'import urllib.request;print(urllib.request.urlopen(\"http://127.0.0.1:8000/health/ready\",timeout=5).read().decode())' \u003eready.json 2\u003e\u00261; docker exec \"$API\" python -m veda.cli schema-status \u003eschema.json 2\u003e\u00261; else echo 'api container not running' \u003eready.json; fi","{ ss -lntu; } \u003elisteners.txt 2\u003e\u00261","{ findmnt /var/lib/veda; df -h; } \u003estorage.txt 2\u003e\u00261","{ systemctl list-timers veda-health.timer --no-pager; /opt/aws/amazon-cloudwatch-agent/bin/amazon-cloudwatch-agent-ctl -a status; } \u003eservices.txt 2\u003e\u00261","tail -n 200 /var/log/veda/deploy.log \u003edeploy-log-tail.txt 2\u003e/dev/null || echo 'no deploy yet' \u003edeploy-log-tail.txt","sha256sum *.txt *.json \u003eMANIFEST.sha256","tar -czf \"/tmp/$LABEL-$TS.tgz\" -C \"$D\" .","SUM=$(sha256sum \"/tmp/$LABEL-$TS.tgz\" | cut -d' ' -f1); KEY=\"host/$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)/$IID/$LABEL-$TS.tgz\"","aws s3 cp --region ap-south-1 \"/tmp/$LABEL-$TS.tgz\" \"s3://veda-evidence-111122223333/$KEY\" --metadata \"sha256=$SUM\"","rm -rf \"$D\" \"/tmp/$LABEL-$TS.tgz\"","echo \"evidence s3://veda-evidence-111122223333/$KEY sha256 $SUM\""],"timeoutSeconds":"600"},"name":"collect"}],"parameters":{"label":{"allowedPattern":"^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,39}$","description":"Evidence label (e.g. e2e-lead-flow)","type":"String"}},"schemaVersion":"2.2"}

after.content: {"description":"Deploy a Veda release to the staging host (bundle verified by SHA-256, image by digest)","mainSteps":[{"action":"aws:runShellScript","inputs":{"runCommand":["set -euo pipefail","TAG='{{ releaseTag }}' DIGEST='{{ imageDigest }}' SUM='{{ bundleSha256 }}'","REL=/opt/veda/releases/$TAG; mkdir -p \"$REL\" /var/log/veda","exec \u003e \u003e(tee -a /var/log/veda/deploy.log) 2\u003e\u00261","echo \"veda-deploy $TAG $(date -u +%FT%TZ)\"","aws s3 cp --region ap-south-1 \"s3://veda-stg-artifacts-111122223333/deploy/$TAG/bundle.tgz\" \"$REL.tgz\"","echo \"$SUM  $REL.tgz\" | sha256sum -c -","tar -xzf \"$REL.tgz\" -C \"$REL\"","install -d /opt/veda/host \u0026\u0026 install -m 0755 \"$REL\"/infra/host/*.sh /opt/veda/host/ \u0026\u0026 install -m 0644 \"$REL\"/infra/host/cloudwatch-agent.json \"$REL\"/infra/host/cloudflared.yml /opt/veda/host/","/opt/veda/host/host-setup.sh /dev/sdf ap-south-1 /opt/veda/host/cloudwatch-agent.json","/opt/veda/host/render-env.sh ap-south-1","aws ecr get-login-password --region ap-south-1 | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin 111122223333.dkr.ecr.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com","docker pull \"111122223333.dkr.ecr.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/veda-api@$DIGEST\"","docker tag \"111122223333.dkr.ecr.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/veda-api@$DIGEST\" \"veda-api:$TAG\"","cd \"$REL/api/deploy\" \u0026\u0026 ./deploy.sh \"$TAG\""],"timeoutSeconds":"1800"},"name":"deploy"}],"parameters":{"bundleSha256":{"allowedPattern":"^[0-9a-f]{64}$","description":"SHA-256 of deploy/\u003ctag\u003e/bundle.tgz","type":"String"},"imageDigest":{"allowedPattern":"^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$","description":"Image digest pushed by 12-deploy","type":"String"},"releaseTag":{"allowedPattern":"^[0-9a-f]{12}$|^r[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+){0,2}$","description":"Release tag (the image tag)","type":"String"}},"schemaVersion":"2.2"}
after.name: veda-deploy
